subject: Request to postpone POC walkthrough — coverage gap + security evidence pending
messages:
From: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@aurelius.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aurelius.com, ian.cheng@aurelius.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — confirming next steps

Hi Aditya / Mina,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We'd like to schedule the POC walkthrough for Aurelius' integration team — key attendees: Claire (product), Ian (security), Procurement inbox.

Ideal window: any day the week of Nov 29; prefer mornings CET. Can you confirm SE coverage + whether you can share the SOC2 summary ahead of the call? Procurement needs that for the vendor checklist before they can commit time.

Also: we will likely want a short mutual action plan (2–3 bullets) captured before the call so our legal/procurement folks know scope.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Dubois
Head of Product Operations, Aurelius Systems
Attachment: none

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@aurelius.com>
Cc: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, procurement@aurelius.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — confirming next steps

Hi Claire — great to hear. We can do mornings CET the week of Nov 29. Propose:
- Tue 30 Nov, 09:30–10:30 CET
- Wed 1 Dec, 10:00–11:00 CET

Stephanie (cc) will lead the demo (SE). Mina will be on for product and procurement coordination. We have a brief SOC2 one-pager we can share immediately — I'll attach a summary and a draft MAP in a follow-up.

If procurement needs a DocuSign or checklist, flag it and we’ll prioritize.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: none (follow-up pending)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:21:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — confirming next steps

On Tue, 17 Nov 2026 at 15:03, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com> wrote:
> Propose:
> - Tue 30 Nov, 09:30–10:30 CET
> - Wed 1 Dec, 10:00–11:00 CET

Quick update from my side — I’m on travel the week of Nov 29 and will be in APAC the 28th–Dec 5th (flight changes). I can do the Wed 1 Dec slot but only if I present asynchronously (pre-record + live Q&A) because of a conflicting customer onsite on my calendar at 10:00–11:00 SGT. Also: our SE team just lost an engineer to attrition and we have limited bench coverage that week.

Two options:
- Option A (preferred): keep the week-of slots but have Monica cover the live demo on Wed 1 Dec and I handle a 20m pre-recorded segment and live Q&A on chat.
- Option B: push the walkthrough to the week of Dec 13 when full SE coverage is available.

I’ll defer to Mina / Aditya on procurement/security timing — new SOC2 docs request could push procurement hold.

— Stephanie
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

From: Ian Cheng <ian.cheng@aurelius.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aurelius.com, claire.dubois@aurelius.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — confirming next steps

Thanks — quick note from Security/Procurement: our vendor intake requires an up-to-date SOC2 summary and a short list of data flows (where tokens/logs live, retention policy) before we schedule an architecture-level walkthrough. Procurement cannot greenlight calendar time for engineers until Security signs off on the checklist.

Can you provide: 
- SOC2 one-page summary or SOC2 report extract
- High-level data flow diagram (can be a bulleted list)
- Contact for data-residency questions (we are EU-first)

If you can share the SOC2 summary today, we can try to keep the week-of Nov 29 slots; otherwise we’ll need to shift.

— Ian Cheng
Security Architect, Aurelius Systems
Attachment: procurement_checklist.xlsx (referenced)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dubois <claire.dubois@aurelius.com>, Ian Cheng <ian.cheng@aurelius.com>, procurement@aurelius.com
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:43:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough — confirming next steps

Claire / Ian / Procurement — thanks for the notes and the checklist.

We should pause firm calendar booking until we close the SOC2/evidence ask and stabilize SE coverage. Proposed path forward: 
1) I’m attaching a SOC2 one-page summary and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps documentation deliverables to dates. Attachment: SOC2_Summary_Aurelius.pdf; Mutual_Action_Plan_Aurelius_v1.docx.
2) Proposed timeline:
   - Nov 20: Redwood to share SOC2 summary + data-residency contact (done; see attached).
   - Nov 23: Aurelius Security to confirm checklist items or ask clarifying Qs.
   - Dec 6–10: Target demo week (SE coverage confirmed). If Aurelius requires earlier access, we can provide a 30m executive overview the week of Nov 29 (Mon/Tue mornings CET) delivered by Aditya + myself; technical deep-dive will move to Dec 6–10.
3) If Procurement requires DocuSign/PO pre-demo, please share the exact DocuSign link or vendor intake form. We can escalate to Contracts if needed.

Action items (owners):
- Mina: upload SOC2 summary and MAP to shared Drive (link below) — done.
- Ian / Aurelius Security: review and reply with remaining checklist items by Nov 23.
- Aditya: hold the proposed time slots and confirm whether an exec overview is acceptable for the week of Nov 29.
- Stephanie / Monica: SE to confirm who will cover live demo by Nov 30.

I’ll create a tentative calendar invite for Dec 8 at 10:00 CET for the technical deep dive and mark it as TENTATIVE until we get security confirmation. If Aurelius prefers an earlier executive summary, we can schedule a 30m slot Mon Nov 29 09:30 CET.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSOC2-EVIDENCE-2026 (SOC2 & MAP)

Thanks everyone — apologies for the churn, but better to align documentation and coverage up-front than to run into a half-staffed technical call.

— Mina Haddad
Senior Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +44 20 7946 0958
Attachment: SOC2_Summary_Aurelius.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan_Aurelius_v1.docx, calendar_invite_20261203.ics
